_doc: Lv, Li & Lu (arXiv 1908.00682) Eq. 1 per level, fixed (no sampling); noise = CBDNet heteroscedastic Gaussian (sigma_s, sigma_c = midpoints of CBDNet's U[0,0.16], U[0,0.06]). Calibrated 2026-11-19 on the 186 Pothole Mix test images (daylight mean luma 0.561) against the NPD dark subset (luma<0.35): mild gamma fitted to NPD p75 0.210 (got 0.210); medium gamma fitted to NPD median 0.146 (got 0.146; jade's proposed 3.0 gives 0.143); severe kept at gamma 5.0, the top of the Lv et al. range, giving 0.087 (~NPD p27) because the noise floor stops it reaching p25 0.081 inside that range.
